trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no extra task behind it, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap: story first, then side missions, activities, collectibles, and finally the cleanup trophies. Keep the checklist in this guide ticked as you go and the platinum will arrive on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is the game's first story mission, so this trophy is unmissable and unlocks naturally as you learn the controls and meet the two leads. Follow the on-screen prompts and finish the mission to the end credits of the scene.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Story missions are marked on the map, so work through them in order and this trophy unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends. Nothing here can be missed, so play at your own pace.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Keep following the main story markers on the map and the trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter's last mission. Like the other chapter trophies, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the chapter where the story opens up into Vice City proper, so expect more side content to appear around you, but the trophy itself only needs the main missions done.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last numbered chapter, and its final mission sets up the endgame. Complete it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission after Chapter 4. It is one of only two gold trophies, and it is unmissable: finish the story and it unlocks. Before you start it, consider saving a manual save slot, since the endgame opens up free roam and cleanup afterwards.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story flow. It unlocks automatically on mission completion, so just play the mission through to its end.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to be longer and multi-stage, so stock up on ammo and armour before starting, then follow the mission objectives to the getaway.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every named story mission trophy, it unlocks on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Expect a combat-heavy mission, so bring a good weapon loadout before you trigger it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story mission, so finish it as part of the normal story flow and the trophy unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen. This is the second gold trophy and the real grind of the platinum: it counts story missions, side missions, activities, collectibles and more. Work through the roadmap in order and use the in-game checklist to find what is left. It pops only when everything is done, so leave it for last, just before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total. Stunts are jumps, near misses, long airtime and similar driving feats, and they count across the whole game, so a big chunk will already be done by the time the story ends. To finish the count quickly, use fast cars and jump ramps around Vice City, or chain stunt jumps, and watch the counter climb in the stats screen.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: fishing, shooting range, drone racing, racing, arcade games, bowling, hunting, and the other open-world activities Leonida offers. You do not need to win or master any of them, just sample each one. Work through the activity icons on the map and the trophy pops when the last type is tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting range, pick each challenge and score gold. Use the weapon the challenge asks for, take your time on the slow-fire targets and keep your aim steady on the timed ones. If a challenge resists you, leave it and come back with a better weapon, since the range stays open after the story.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations across Leonida. Each location has its own course, so find the Top Fun markers on the map and race each one until you win. Learn the course on the first run, then cut corners cleanly on the second; the trophy pops after the last location is won.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races are scattered around Leonida and marked on the map, and each distinct race counts once, so you need variety rather than repeats. Pick fast, grippy cars, learn the braking points, and work through the list of race locations.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, start the challenge and out-fish him. The trick is steady reeling: keep the line tension in the safe zone, reel in when the fish runs toward you, and let it run when it surges. Win the challenge and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Step into an arcade, pick any machine and play it through to the end. You do not need a high score, just a full completion, so choose a game you find easy and finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's mission strand. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses and their missions appear on the map. Work through all of Andy's missions and the trophy pops when the last one ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's mission strand. Follow Kenton's missions on the map until the strand ends; the trophy unlocks when the final mission completes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's mission strand. Work through Billy's missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as question-mark markers on the map and each strand is a short chain of missions for a colourful local character. Do eight full strands and this silver trophy pops. It overlaps with the individual strand trophies, so it is natural to earn it while finishing them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's mission strand. Follow Randy's missions on the map until the strand ends; the trophy unlocks on the final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's mission strand. Work through Tyrone's missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the only missable trophy in the game: one meditation spot sits at Jason's house and is only available in Chapter 1, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends or it is gone for the playthrough. The other 17 spots stay available in free roam. When you reach a spot, use the meditate prompt and wait for the session to complete.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand points you to a rare animal in the wilds of Leonida. Follow the hunting mission markers, track the animal, and take it down with a clean shot. The trophy pops when the hunt is delivered to Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, in shops, interiors and out in the world. Each set needs every card in it, so collect methodically and check the collection screen to see which cards are still missing. Three finished sets earn the silver trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK spots are scattered all over Leonida, and each new location counts once. Open the WAiNK app as you explore, tag each spot you pass, and the counter will climb steadily through normal play; the last stretch is easiest with a map of the remaining spots.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are small objectives spread across activities, combat, driving and exploration, and they tick off in the background as you play. You will clear many of them naturally; for the rest, open the challenges list, pick the easy ones first, and work through them in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Get the police to 4 stars by causing chaos in a populated area, then break line of sight, hide in an alley or switch vehicles, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. The trophy pops once you escape with your partner beside you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route of three nearby shops, rob each one quickly, and keep moving so the wanted level never drops between robberies. A fast getaway car parked outside each shop makes the chain much easier.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle model you drive or enter for the first time counts, so variety is the key: borrow cars, bikes, boats and trucks wherever you see them. The count climbs fast in the early game and the last few are found by hunting down rare models around Leonida.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and line up your shots quickly while time slows. Enemies in a gang hideout or a shootout mission work well; aim for headshots and keep moving between targets.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport. Get onto the airfield, grab a plane or a helicopter, and take off without following the airport's normal flow. The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and at military areas, so provoke a heavy police response or head for a military site, climb in, and the trophy pops once you are driving it. Expect a lot of attention from the army while you are in it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quietly: wait until the shop is empty or the staff are distracted, avoid the cameras and the alarm, grab the goods and slip out before anyone notices. If you are spotted, leave and try again later.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vault robberies are bigger jobs than shop robberies: plan the approach, break into the vault, grab the cash and escape before the police lock the area down. Five successful vault jobs earn the silver trophy.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; intercept one, stop it, break it open and grab the cash, then lose the wanted level. A sticky bomb or a heavy vehicle makes stopping the truck much easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and sail through every named area on the map, from Vice City to the swamps and the keys. The in-game map tracks which areas you have visited, so use it to find the gaps and sweep through the remaining ones in free roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own illegal operations around Leonida, marked on the map. Hit one operation per gang, nine in total, and the trophy pops. Work through the gang territories one at a time.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, order a cocktail and enjoy it. This is a simple vibe trophy: go to the beachfront, sit down at a bar, buy a drink and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through the front of a vehicle showroom and smash your way out. Pick a showroom, build up speed inside or outside, and crash straight through the glass. It is a homage to the classic series moment, so any showroom with a big glass front will do.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a game. Find the alley on the map, start a game and bowl through to the end of it. You do not need a high score, just a finished game, so take your time with the aim and the power.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Complete the partnership moment this trophy describes. It is a story-adjacent trophy that unlocks through a specific scene with your partner, so play the story and it will come naturally. If it has not popped by the end of the story, check which partner activity or scene is still outstanding.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make story choices that shape the game. This trophy tracks the choices you make through the story, and PlayStation tracks a count up to 500 for it. Keep playing the story and making decisions when the game asks; the trophy pops once the required choices are made.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try at something you failed the first time. This pops naturally: fail an activity, mission or challenge once, then succeed at the same thing on the next attempt. It is hard to miss across a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida. The state hides odd encounters and easter eggs, from strange lights to stranger locals. Explore off the beaten path, especially at night and in remote areas, and the trophy pops when you stumble across one of these moments.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, lean out and swing a melee weapon as you pass. A bat works well, and a quiet street makes it easy to line up. One clean hit earns the trophy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts will wash them for clean cash. Keep laundering after every big score and the total will climb; the trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Weapons, clothes, cars, food and ammo all count, so this climbs on its own as you kit yourself out. If you are short near the end, buy an expensive vehicle or a full weapon loadout to push past the mark.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garage properties appear for sale on the in-game property sites and around the map. Buy each one as you can afford it; the trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours. Garages also give you safe storage for your vehicle collection.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register each one. Ten registrations earn the trophy, and the app keeps your registered rides easy to call back.
trophies.name: On the Spot
